claims.statement: For every binary s by m matrix M of rank r>=1, every affine phase, P(x,y)=(-1)^{x^TMy+a.x+b.y+c}(1-2 1_{y=0}), every arbitrary Boolean h on a disjoint block, and every finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction tree querying only P variables, U(Ph)-sum_l w_l U((Ph)_l) <= (25/4) I_{x,y}(P). Also U(P)<=H(P)<=(25/4)I(P).
claims.quantifiers: All s,m>=1; all ranks r>=1; all binary matrices and overlaps; all affine phases; all finite adaptive/pruned restriction trees; all disjoint Boolean terminal cores; base-2 units.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent nonreused retained-credit bound is proved for multiple point-defect cylinders or arbitrary nonflat shared cores.
claims.delta: The gap is removed for one point-defect cylinder coupled to an arbitrary-rank affine-bilinear control, with constants independent of the number and overlap of selector centres.
